title: ByteGAN BiGAN: 256-Byte Bidirectional 1-to-1 Dictionary
intuition: Extends `bytegan_hypercube8` with a joint BiGAN encoder E(x) and joint critic D(x, z), requiring both 256/256 unique generated bytes AND 256/256 exact bidirectional dictionary reconstructions G(E(x)) == x.
failure_mode: Even partial generative coverage fails inverse lookup completely (0/256 exact reconstructions without joint atomic inverse codebook contraction).
protocol_notes: Tier-4 stretch task and Four Laws Adherence Law 1 anchor (6,000 updates).
